title: チワワの花すけ～おねえさん ごめんなさい (Chihuahua Hanasuke: Big Sister, I'm Sorry)
description: 花すけはチワワの男の子。今日はひとりでお留守番。おねえさんのかばんで遊んでしまいます。A chihuahua named Hanasuke is home alone and can't resist playing with his big sister's bag. A gentle story about mischief and apology at Tadoku Level 0.
author: 丸山京子 (Maruyama Kyōko), NPO多言語多読
